facts.fact: Décret n° 2026-101 of 31 March 2026 (published 9 July 2026) cites as a legal basis the loi n° 37-2019 of 12 December 2019 relative aux transactions électroniques, treating it as an existing law; the passages held do not describe its content.
facts.system: Loi n° 37-2019 relative aux transactions électroniques

facts.fact: The decree cites among its legal basis the décret n° 2025-514 of 29 December 2025 fixing the characteristics of the device for creating and verifying electronic signatures; the passages held do not say under which law it was made.
facts.system: Décret n° 2025-514 fixant les caractéristiques du dispositif de création et de vérification de la signature électronique

systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts et des domaines (DGID)
